amount.description: What it settled, in the bill's currency.

base.description: The bill's carrying amount it cleared, in the base currency: the amount at the bill's stored rate, and for the part that settles what is left of a bill, what was left (ENG-14).

realised_fx.description: The realised gain (positive) or loss (negative) in the base currency: the amount at the payment's rate against the bill's stored rate, with no tolerance (ENG-41).

tolerance.description: For a bill paid in full with a little less: the carrying amount the settlement difference cleared to 7030, in the base currency (FR-BNK-08).
